milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The tripwire hooks and string are at spawn-relative (0, 1, 5) stretched across the corridor at eye level. The player must walk forward from spawn toward the corridor and face the tripwire area. max_distance=4 ensures the player has moved past the spawn area (at least to z≥1) and is close enough to clearly see the hooks. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the tripwire, not away from it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The piston stack is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 7) at the end of the corridor. The player must navigate through the corridor past the tripwire to reach the piston area. max_distance=5 ensures the player has walked well into the corridor (at least past the doorway at z=3) and is close enough to clearly identify the piston. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the piston face.
